# eon_gcs_bucket_configuration (Resource)

Manages GCS bucket backup method configuration for an inventory resource. `scan_detection_method` controls event-notification based scan detection. `full_scan_method` controls inventory-based full scans. Deleting this resource resets both methods to `AUTO`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Force GCS event notifications for scan detection and use auto full-scan selection.
resource "eon_gcs_bucket_configuration" "bucket" {
  resource_id = "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d" # GCS bucket resource ID in Eon

  scan_detection_method = "FORCE_ENABLED"
  full_scan_method      = "AUTO"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the GCS bucket inventory resource.

### Optional

- `full_scan_method` (String) Full-scan method. Supported values: `AUTO`, `FORCE_ENABLED`, `FORCE_DISABLED`.
- `scan_detection_method` (String) Scan detection method. Supported values: `AUTO`, `FORCE_ENABLED`, `FORCE_DISABLED`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource. Mirrors `resource_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import eon_gcs_bucket_configuration.bucket "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d"
```
